Portada.invitacion: Sign in to see your products and transfer money.
Portada.heroDescripcion: A reference Chilean core banking platform: event-driven microservices, double-entry ledger and a GraphQL BFF. A portfolio project built to be explored in minutes.
Portada.highlightIdempotencia: Idempotent transfers (a retry never duplicates the movement).
Portada.highlightEventos: Event-driven architecture: Kafka + Outbox pattern + Saga with compensation.
Portada.highlightSeguridad: OIDC authentication with Keycloak (Authorization Code + PKCE) and roles.
Portada.highlightGraphql: API Gateway with a GraphQL BFF aggregating accounts, balances and history.
Portada.highlightObservabilidad: Observability (metrics, traces, logs) and infrastructure as code.
Portada.tourNota: Once you're in, a guided tour walks you through the dashboard (accounts, transfer and history).
Portada.demoTitulo: Are you a recruiter? Get in without signing up
Portada.demoDescripcion: The «Enter as guest» button opens Keycloak with the username already filled in; just confirm with the demo password. Once inside you'll get a guided tour of the dashboard.
Portada.demoSoloDemo: Credentials for the public demo only.
Portada.enlacesTitulo: Explore the API and the code

cuentas.cuerpo: Here you see your accounts and the balance of each one, formatted in Chilean pesos (es-CL).

transferir.cuerpo: Pick the source account, enter the destination account and the amount. You'll see the process status live.

historial.cuerpo: Each transfer shows up here as sent or received, with its status. It refreshes after you transfer.

Panel.errorSinRut: We couldn't determine your RUT to look up your products. Set DEMO_RUT or map the 'rut' claim in Keycloak.
Panel.errorBffGenerico: An error occurred while querying the BFF.
Panel.sinCuentasParaTransferir: You need at least one source account to transfer.

Transferencia.sesionExpirada: Your session expired. Sign in again to transfer.
Transferencia.seleccionaCuentas: Select the source and destination accounts.
Transferencia.cuentasDistintas: The source and destination accounts must be different.
Transferencia.montoInvalido: Enter a valid amount in pesos (positive integer).
